messages:
Maya: Quick sync — pricing/packaging change incoming. We need to lock owners for metering, billing, quota enforcement, and contracts. Who's taking which lane and what's the rough timeline?
Sam: I own metering changes (metering service). Planning to open a PR Thu EOD. Need billing and consumer changes coordinated.
Jonah: Billing (Stripe) here — we need the final plan mapping from product and to confirm whether SKUs replace or map to existing plans. If SKUs change semantics, we may need a backfill for historical usage.
Liz: Contracts: important callout — enterprise contracts require 30d notice for pricing/quota changes. Dedicated/custom clauses will be handled case-by-case. We can prepare a standard notice but legal signoff needed.
Maya: @Liz can you draft a default notice by Tue? We'll hold rollout for any customers that need notice. @Jonah what format do you need for plan mapping?
Jonah: CSV is easiest. Columns: customer_id, old_plan, new_plan, effective_date, quota_override. Example:
```csv
customer_id,old_plan,new_plan,effective_date,quota_override
acct_123,basic,pro,2026-05-01,500000
```
Sam: Metering note — we'll tag tokens with new sku_id in ingestion pipeline. Need billing-webhooks consumer updated to accept sku_id. I can open the metering + consumer PRs tomorrow. Plan to canary the tag flow.
Anna: For quota enforcement we likely need a mapping table. Suggest adding quota_override column and backfilling async. Sample SQL to add column and index:
```sql
ALTER TABLE plan_mappings ADD COLUMN quota_override bigint DEFAULT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_plan_map_cust ON plan_mappings(customer_id);
-- run backfill in 10k row batches, use write throttling
```
Can estimate migration time once I know row counts.
Sam: Also: update to billing consumer should be backward compatible — accept missing sku_id and fall back to plan code.
Maya: Action items: 1) Liz draft notice by Tue; 2) Jonah put CSV template in shared drive by EOW; 3) Sam open metering + consumer PRs tomorrow; 4) Anna estimate DB migration effort (hrs) by EOD today; 5) Product (me) to lock final plan names.
Jonah: Ack — will drop template and ping here. :thumbsup:
Liz: Ack, will loop in legal reviewers once draft is ready.
billing-bot: Heads-up — remember to invalidate quotes service cache when plan mapping changes. Admin purge endpoint: POST /admin/cache/purge
Maya: Thanks all. If no blockers we target a canary on 2026-04-15. I'll update the main ticket and send a calendar invite for a rollout pre-check on 2026-04-13.
